baseline_models.mechanism: The choice-balanced member converts an earlier utterance into preventive counsel: tasbih can encompass worship, thanks, and a God-willing exception, so the recalled speech was meant to qualify collective intention before its consequences arrived.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies both the original warning and its now-audible recall, making neglect rather than ignorance the issue.
Just and choice balance identifies the speaker as the member able to restrain an excessive collective intention.
Worship, thanks, remembrance, and God-willing exception make tasbih a practical qualification of action, not praise detached from it.

changed_reading.before: A generally better member scolds the others for failing to praise God.
changed_reading.after: A balanced member recalls an ignored preventive utterance that should have placed gratitude and contingency inside the group's intention.

baseline_models.mechanism: A member situated between parties intervenes through negotiated speech. On the purification branch, tasbih is an act of declaring free from wrong attribution, so the intervention seeks to repair both the group's relation to one another and the premise under which they interpret what occurred.

activation_trace.role: Mediation between people makes the speaker an internal relational operator rather than merely the highest-ranked individual.
Mutual verbal negotiation lets the remembered saying function as an attempt to reopen a collective decision.
Purification and declaring free make tasbih a corrective attribution that clears the divine from the group's projected fault.

changed_reading.before: The morally best man delivers a one-way reprimand.
changed_reading.after: An insider mediates a failed collective process by reopening speech and calling for a purification of attribution.

baseline_models.mechanism: The middle can name a middling rank between good and bad. The speaker may therefore be the least distorted or first self-correcting participant without being an innocent moral summit; correct speech can emerge from partial implication.

activation_trace.role: Middling rank resists automatically converting awsat into complete moral excellence.
The explicit recalled utterance gives this imperfect insider a real prior dissent rather than inventing innocence for him.
Purifying attribution is the correction he voiced, while the verse itself does not state that he fully separated from the group.

changed_reading.before: A blameless superior stands over a guilty group.
changed_reading.after: A comparatively balanced but potentially implicated insider is the first to recover the corrective distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group's apportioned oath hardens into cutting and separation precisely where exception is absent. This activates the exception included in the focus tasbih inventory as the missing hinge that could have bent an absolute plan back toward accountable contingency.

activation_trace.role: The tasbih branch explicitly includes God-willing exception, supplying the focus-side brake on categorical intention.
An oath distributed across its people binds the collective plan and gives the warning a specific object to qualify.
Cutting and separation supply the plan's terminal motion: certainty aims at a clean severance.
Exception as removal from a total set names exactly the flexibility the negated construction says they omitted.

structural_cues: The oath to cut is followed immediately by explicit non-exception, while the focus recalls a prior plural warning after the result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, severance, absent exception, and a tasbih branch that includes saying God willing; I infer that tasbih would have interrupted the oath's totalizing force. A live alternative is that the warning asked for gratitude or worship without requiring a spoken formula.

changed_reading.before: Why did you not add a pious phrase to your plan?
changed_reading.after: Why did you not install a real contingency inside the oath, preventing resolve from becoming total severance?

context_deltas.mechanism: Withholding a hand from beneficial generosity becomes low secret speech aimed at blocking a poor person's entry; the speakers then name themselves deprived. The focus branch of sabh as room for movement and livelihood activates tasbih as a practice that keeps benefit circulating instead of enclosing it.

activation_trace.role: Room for going about and livelihood turns tasbih into an anti-blockage image: sustenance remains mobile rather than privately stopped.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the social action that the focus warning can oppose.
Generosity and gift specify the good whose circulation is being stopped.
Lowered secret speech shows the exclusion being socially coordinated outside open corrective hearing.
Entry into an interior supplies the boundary the group intends to close against another.
The abasement of poverty identifies who bears the intended exclusion and keeps the model materially specific.
Loss of the desired thing reverses deprivation onto those who tried to administer it to someone else.

structural_cues: The intended non-entry of a poor person is followed by the planners' own first-person declaration of deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld good, covert exclusion, blocked entry, poverty, self-deprivation, and sabh as livelihood room; I infer a reversal in which stopping another's access stops the planners' own access. The live alternative keeps tasbih at gratitude for provision rather than making circulation itself its image.

changed_reading.before: The omitted act was an exception formula attached to harvesting.
changed_reading.after: The omitted tasbih was also an ethic of keeping livelihood open: their attempt to stop another's access returns as their own deprivation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next utterance performs the focus proposal: tasbih is followed by first-person self-indictment. Purifying the Lord from wrong attribution and naming the self's misplacement form one operation, while subsequent mutual blame shows that vertical correction does not instantly settle horizontal fault.

activation_trace.role: Purification and declaring free supply the attributional operation requested in the focus.
The group now externalizes the very speech act whose prior omission the middle member recalled.
Actual purification realizes the focus imperative and marks a changed interpretive state.
Putting something outside its proper time or place lets the confession relocate disorder onto the speakers' own action.
Mutual deserved blame exposes the still-unresolved interpersonal allocation of fault after the divine attribution is corrected.

structural_cues: The response sequence is utterance, tasbih of our Lord, first-person plural wrongdoing, and then reciprocal blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence purification then self-ascription then mutual blame; I infer a directional transfer of fault away from the Lord and onto human action. A live alternative treats tasbih as a devotional preface to confession rather than the mechanism that reorganizes blame.

changed_reading.before: The middle member asks for praise in the face of loss.
changed_reading.after: He asks for an attributional correction: clear the Lord of fault, then identify the human misplacement without pretending peer blame is already resolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later plural confessions of misplacement and boundary-crossing reactivate the middling branch of awsat. The corrective speaker belongs to their group and may be the first lucid participant rather than an exempt moral observer.

activation_trace.role: Middling rank keeps the speaker between good and bad, allowing correct counsel without presuming complete innocence.
Plural admission of misplacement supplies a collective diagnosis broad enough to include an implicated corrector.
Plural boundary transgression deepens the shared diagnosis beyond a single bad decision or a single guilty member.

structural_cues: The focus calls him one of them; the following moral diagnoses remain first-person plural rather than exempting a named speaker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group membership and plural confessions; I infer that the middle speaker remains within their scope, so prior dissent mitigates but does not automatically absolve him. The live alternative is that the later plural excludes the one who had warned them.

changed_reading.before: A righteous outsider within the scene proves that he was right.
changed_reading.after: An implicated insider recovers the right distinction first and helps a collective confession emerge without claiming exemption.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions test judgment by asking for its governing record, its studied warrant, and its responsible guarantor. Against that sequence, the middle member's forceful speech is authorized by balance and fulfilled warning, not by mere title, assertion, or a self-serving rule.

activation_trace.role: Just and choice balance supplies the quality by which the speaker's intervention can be measured.
The image of a chief whose word has force raises the authority question without requiring the speaker literally to hold that title.
Judgment between people turns the later question into an audit of how normative distinctions are being made.
An inscription that obligates a ruling supplies the absent external warrant against which assertions are tested.
Following a book through reading and retention makes claimed judgment answerable to sustained examination.
Speech without certainty supplies the negative image of assertion that lacks balanced warrant.

structural_cues: The later interrogative sequence moves from how you judge, to what book you study, to who will stand behind the claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a balanced speaker and a later chain testing judgments, records, study, and claims; I infer a contrast between warranted corrective speech and self-authorized verdicts. The title-like qawl branch is analogical, and the live alternative leaves the later questions unrelated to the garden dialogue.

changed_reading.before: The middle member's authority comes from being the group's best person.
changed_reading.after: His remembered saying becomes a small test case in warranted judgment: force comes from balance, prior evidence, and accountable correction rather than unsupported assertion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later call to embodied lowering meets explicit inability, while the focus addresses people who can still hear and answer. Tasbih becomes a practice of keeping response supple during the interval when voluntary acknowledgment remains enactable.

activation_trace.role: Worship, remembrance, and voluntary devotion make the focus invitation an enactable discipline rather than an abstract proposition.
Calling and inclining through speech echoes the focus member's verbal invitation at a later, exposed moment.
Lowering and submission give bodily form to the acknowledgment requested through tasbih.
Capacity and ability make the explicit inability a closure of the earlier opportunity to respond.

structural_cues: The focus poses a live second-person invitation; the later scene pairs renewed call and submission with explicit inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier verbal invitation and a later call whose embodied response is impossible; I infer that repeated voluntary acknowledgment preserves responsiveness and that refusal can close a capacity window. A live alternative reads the later inability only as exposure of settled character, not as loss caused by neglected practice.

changed_reading.before: The group missed a devotional courtesy at one decision point.
changed_reading.after: The warning addresses a closing capacity window: practice acknowledgment while hearing can still become willing embodied response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fish-companion sequence places a raised call inside blocked breath, then gives a counterfactual catch that prevents casting into exposed space. The motion and livelihood-room branches of sabh activate tasbih as vocal movement that keeps or reopens a passage under constriction.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and coursing supply motion through a surrounding medium as the kinetic image for a voice that does not remain trapped.
Room for movement supplies the opening that the constricted call lacks and that rescue restores.
A raised call gives the constricted scene an actual vocal motion rather than silent inward distress.
A blocked outlet after filling supplies the material obstruction through which the call must pass.
Catching and reaching supplies the interceptive motion that prevents the counterfactual expulsion.
Throwing and casting name the outward trajectory that the catch interrupts.
Open unshielded space supplies the exposed endpoint of being cast out, contrasting with recovered room to move.

structural_cues: The focus and 68:49 share a lawla construction; the later one explicitly opposes being caught by grace to being cast into exposure after a call under constriction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, blocked outlet, catch, casting, exposure, and sabh as motion and room; I connect them as a rescuing vocal movement through constriction. This is an analogical mechanism, and the live alternative treats the later lawla only as divine intervention with no kinetic activation of focus tasbih.

changed_reading.before: Tasbih is a verbal acknowledgment made from a stable position.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, tasbih is a voice that swims out of enclosure, creating a rescuable passage before constriction ends in exposed expulsion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping from qawl to fewness, not the ordinary sense of qala. It remains valid as a packet-supplied activation anchored in the repeated focus root and the central-position branch of awsat: a socially or numerically scarce warning can occupy structural center. Downstream prose should present it as a minority-voice image, never as a lexical claim that qala means few.

activation_trace.role: Fewness and smallness activate the warning as a scarce voice inside a plural group rather than a majority position.
Central position gives the scarce utterance leverage: numerical marginality and structural centrality can coexist.

changed_reading.before: The recognized best member speaks with established group authority.
changed_reading.after: A scarce or minority warning becomes the group's true center only when events reveal the value of what it had said.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cutting-in-half branch is form-distant from awsat as a person and the model is structural rather than lexical. It remains anchored in the focus middle and activated by the packet's repeated severance and bending images: the utterance interrupts a plan organized around a clean cut. Downstream prose should call it a counter-cut analogy, not translate awsat as cutter.

activation_trace.role: Cutting a thing into halves activates the middle speaker as the point where a unanimous plan can be interrupted.
Cutting and separation make the group's intended action a cut that the middle intervention can counter rather than complete.
Folding, bending, and turning supply the alternative geometry: exception bends the straight severing trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The person in the middle comments after the collective plan has failed.
changed_reading.after: The middle voice is an attempted counter-cut inside the plan, bending its drive toward total severance before consequence performs a harsher cut.

strongest_changes: Tasbih becomes the missing contingency that could have bent a collective oath away from total severance.
The immediate response performs tasbih as relocation of fault from the Lord to the group's own misplaced action.
The exclusion-deprivation reversal activates tasbih as keeping good and livelihood in circulation.
The later inability to submit turns the focus warning into a time-sensitive invitation while response remains possible.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained devotional, social-material, juridical, embodied, and kinetic readings at once. The strongest mechanisms did not collapse tasbih into one gloss, and the split qawl mapping plus the cutting branch of awsat preserved two contained readings a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus may foreground God-willing exception, gratitude, purification of attribution, or all three without ranking them.
Awsat can support choice excellence, mediation, central position, or middling complicity; the packet does not force one social profile.
The circulation, kinetic, minority-voice, and counter-cut models are branch activations and should not be promoted into direct lexical translations.
